title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Revenue Administration and Revenue Policy -Tanzania

description.narrative: Enhancing the effectiveness of audits of businesses in telecommunications, tourism, construction and financial instruments; Ensuring that progress made by the Tanzania Revenue Authority in the audit of transfer pricing issues on multinational enterprises continues; Expanding the capabilities of the Tax Investigations Department in deterring and combating tax fraud; Assisting with issues that arise in the acquisition and deployment of the New Integrated Domestic Revenue System (IDRAS); and, developing TRAs effectiveness in tax administration for the oil and gas industry.
